toolchain_analysis.algorithm: CHECK_FN reads SERIAL as KS-<8 hex>-<2 hex>, decodes four body bytes, XORs them, and compares the result to the checksum byte. LICENSE_BLOB is the same 5-byte sequence.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import hashlib
import sys

TARGET = "samples/keystone_check.py"
CHECK_FN = "CHECK_FN"
OFFSET = "OFFSET"
PATCH_BYTE = "PATCH_BYTE"

def keygen(seed: str) -> str:
    body = hashlib.sha256(seed.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:8]
    checksum = 0
    for index in range(0, 8, 2):
        checksum ^= int(body[index:index + 2], 16)
    serial = "KS-{}-{:02x}".format(body, checksum)
    return serial

def main() -> int:
    seed = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "local-fixture"
    serial = keygen(seed)
    license_blob = serial
    print("TARGET", TARGET)
    print("CHECK_FN", CHECK_FN)
    print("OFFSET", OFFSET)
    print("PATCH_BYTE", PATCH_BYTE)
    print("SERIAL", serial)
    print("LICENSE_BLOB", license_blob)
    return 0

if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
